title: Thank-you SMS when a customer pays
summary: When Paystack confirms a payment, text the customer a thank-you with the amount.
description: Whenever Paystack reports a successful payment, sends the customer an SMS thanking them, with the amount received and the payment reference, in your business's name. Payments without a phone number on the customer are skipped.

params.name: closing_line
params.title: Closing line
params.description: A short line at the end of the message.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The Paystack connection whose webhooks start this workflow.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

definition.name: Thank-you SMS when a customer pays

steps.name: Use your business name and closing line

input.sms: ='Thank you' + (has(trigger.body.data.customer.first_name) && trigger.body.data.customer.first_name != null ? ', ' + trigger.body.data.customer.first_name : '') + '! ' + steps.settings.output.business_name + ' received NGN ' + string(double(trigger.body.data.amount) / 100.0) + ' (ref ' + trigger.body.data.reference + '). ' + steps.settings.output.closing_line
